How do I use it properly the very first time?

Use it like this the first time: sign in during your shopping window, open your cart with “Edit Cart,” remove anything you do not want, add what you do want, then review the total and leave it there. There is no checkout button, if your cart meets the minimum by the end of your shopping window, it processes automatically at 11:45 PM ET on the last day of that window. If you choose Flex, you start with an empty cart and need to add items yourself, and if you choose weekly, you start with a pre-filled cart you can edit.
